name: chat
summary: AI assistant chat with streamed, fading-in replies, Thinking state and a Stop button.
props: The conversation. Controlled when onSend is set; otherwise the starting messages for the built-in simulation.
The user sent a prompt (trimmed). Append it and the reply to messages yourself. Without it, replies are simulated from a canned list so the screen works as-is.
A reply is in flight: “Thinking…” until the last message is an assistant one with text, a caret while it grows, and Send becomes Stop.
Chips above the input until the user sends something; tapping one sends it. [] hides them.
Used in the header, the placeholder and screen reader labels.
Header text. The subtitle shows “Thinking…” / “Typing…” while streaming.
Replace the header; null hides it.
Replace the assistant mark beside replies, in the header and the empty state.
plain: assistant text sits on the page. bubbles: assistant replies in muted bubbles too (support bots).
What shows before the first token.
Shows a + button left of the input.
Copy pressed or a message long-pressed — write message.text to the clipboard here. The icon turns into a check.
Regenerate pressed on the latest reply.
Thumbs toggled; null when cleared. Initial state comes from message.feedback.
Shows a new-chat button in the header (the simulation also clears itself).
Extra padding under the input, e.g. useSafeAreaInsets().bottom. Ignored while the keyboard is open.
Height above the screen (navigator header) so the input clears the keyboard exactly.
Light haptics on send, stop, copy and feedback.
User bubbles, send button, focus ring and the assistant mark.
behavior: Tap a suggestion chip to send it. Long-press a message to copy it; the row under each reply has copy, thumbs up / down and regenerate (latest reply). A round button jumps back to the latest message after scrolling up.

Messages rise and fade in on a spring, new words fade in as they stream with a soft blinking caret, “Thinking…” shimmers (or dots bounce), and the send arrow spins into a stop square. Opacity and transforms run on the native driver.
No per-word fade, shimmer, bouncing dots or caret blink; simulated replies arrive in larger chunks and messages appear without the rise.

Messages read as “You: …” and “<assistant>: …” with markdown stripped, and long-press copy is exposed as an action. “<assistant> is thinking” is announced, then the full reply when streaming ends. Buttons have roles, labels and disabled / selected state.

The prompt stays above the keyboard on iOS and Android (KeyboardAvoidingView; pass keyboardVerticalOffset under a navigator header) and bottomInset is dropped while it is open. On web, Enter sends and Shift+Enter adds a line.
A light tap on send, stop and copy, and a selection tick on chips, thumbs and regenerate (native only, haptics={false} to turn off).
